item.noellesroles.crystal_ball.desc: Diviner exclusive. Right-click while aiming at a corpse to begin a 10-second channel (you must stay still). When complete, it reveals the time of death plus a random clue about the killer (one of three: whether the killer is alive/dead + their name, the killer's role, or a 1-second global highlight of the killer). 50%% chance to shatter, 60-second cooldown. If the divined corpse is one disguised by a Dead Whisperer, it counts as the killer having stabbed themselves.
item.noellesroles.deduction_book.desc: Great Detective exclusive. Right-click to open and review the clues you have gathered; right-click a corpse while staying still to investigate. Each page corresponds to one killer; once you have >=3 clues you may choose to learn the killer's position or whether they are alive.
item.exposure.photograph_frame.desc: The Photographer's exclusive item. Costs 200 coins, may be bought at most twice per round. Can be placed even in Adventure mode. After placing a photo taken by the Photographer into the item frame, any player who walks through the frame is teleported to the photo's shooting location; each passage blinds you for 3 seconds and imposes a 3-second cooldown before you can pass again. Only frames placed by the Photographer are cleared at round start.
item.noellesroles.wizard_staff.desc: Wizard exclusive. Right-click to charge and release a magic fire arrow that can pierce multiple players; landing 2 hits on the same target kills them after 3 seconds. No cooldown before a kill; after a kill it enters the same cooldown as the knife. Left-click knocks the target back. When Explosion! is ready, the next cast becomes a wall-piercing 9th-tier fireball.
item.noellesroles.wizard_potion.desc: Wizard exclusive. Using it applies a 160-second vanilla item cooldown, grants 150 mana and 1 stack of timed shield; if no players are killed while the shield lasts, then when the shield expires or is broken, 150 mana is deducted and half of your current mana is additionally deducted.
item.trainmurdermystery.bat.desc: Vanilla attack logic, left-click to hit. Cannot attack while in a wheelchair.
item.trainmurdermystery.defense_vial.des:
A Loose End may right-click to drink directly and gain a shield.
Normal players may right-click a tray to pour the defense potion onto it.
The next player to take the defense potion gains a shield after eating or drinking an item.
This method grants at most 1 stack of shield.
item.noellesroles.bucket_of_h2so4.desc:
The Cleaner's item.
Right-click a corpse to dissolve it.
item.noellesroles.c4.desc: Right-click to throw. If thrown at a player, it sticks to that player; otherwise it sticks to the block where it lands. When the C4 is armed it beeps; if not disarmed in time, it explodes after a few seconds, killing all players within 7 blocks. The blast can pierce 1-block-thick walls but not 2-block-thick walls. When a player bound with C4 dies, the C4 drops to the ground and continues its countdown. When C4 is disarmed with bolt cutters by anyone other than a Fitter, there is a 20%% chance it detonates immediately.
item.noellesroles.c4_detonator.desc: Right-click to arm the thrown C4s in the area one by one. Can detonate multiple C4s at once.
item.noellesroles.camera_shears.desc: Has 3 durability, 30-second cooldown. Right-click a camera to disable it for 90 seconds.
item.noellesroles.cooked_food.desc: Cooked by the Chef. Carries various effects after cooking.
item.noellesroles.letter.desc: When task-point see-through is active, holding the envelope lets you see vending machines.
item.noellesroles.master_key.desc: A key that can open any door. Is blocked by an Engineer's lock, but failing to pick it does not consume the master key. Drops on death.
item.noellesroles.master_key_p.desc: A key that can open ordinary wooden doors. Has a limited number of uses. Is blocked by an Engineer's lock.
item.noellesroles.noell_artisan_key.desc: An artisan key cut by a Locksmith. Can directly open a door regardless of installed items or a deadbolt, without damaging reinforcing items on the door. Does not drop on death.
item.noellesroles.noell_key_blank.desc: A Locksmith's key-cutting item. Right-click to enter the key-cutting minigame; success or failure consumes 1 key blank.
item.noellesroles.noell_paperclip.desc: One-time door-opening item. Can directly open a door that is not deadbolted.
item.trainmurdermystery.iron_door_key.de: A key that can open iron doors. Has a limited number of uses.
item.trainmurdermystery.key.desc:
A key used to open your own room.
When task-point see-through is active, holding the key lets you see your own room door.
item.starrailexpress.knife.desc: Melee weapon. Left-click knocks players back; right-click raises the knife and slashes down after a moment, stabbing the player to death.
item.starrailexpress.knife.durability_hi: Limited-durability mode: this knife has only %s durability. It does not disappear when durability runs out but cannot be used; you must buy a replacement at the shop.
item.starrailexpress.bat.desc: Melee weapon. Left-click attacks with an attack interval; spamming clicks deals no damage.
item.starrailexpress.crowbar.desc: Right-click to permanently pry a door open. Can be repaired by a Locksmith using a screwdriver.
item.starrailexpress.grenade.desc: Thrown weapon. Right-click to throw, killing players within a radius of the landing point. Hold right-click to charge and throw farther. The grenade is blocked by player entities. When an Angler hooks a grenade, it does not enter the inventory; instead it flies out from the bobber as a grenade entity and explodes on landing.
item.trainmurdermystery.grenade.desc: Thrown weapon. Right-click to throw, killing players within a radius of the landing point. Hold right-click to charge and throw farther. The grenade is blocked by player entities. When an Angler hooks a grenade, it does not enter the inventory; instead it flies out from the bobber as a grenade entity and explodes on landing.
item.trainmurdermystery.sticky_grenade.d: Sticky grenade. After being thrown, it sticks to the landing point or a player and explodes after a short delay; when stuck to a player it can be removed with bolt cutters. When hooked by an Angler, it flies out from the bobber as a sticky grenade entity.
item.trainmurdermystery.timed_grenade.de: Timed-delay grenade. After being charged and thrown, it bounces off blocks and explodes when the countdown ends. When hooked by an Angler, it flies out from the bobber as a timed grenade entity.
item.starrailexpress.firecracker.desc: Right-click to place on the ground; fires a gunshot after 15s.
item.starrailexpress.revolver.desc: The most basic ranged weapon. Right-click to shoot.
item.starrailexpress.derringer.desc: Has only a 2-second cooldown; ammo only regenerates on hitting a player or getting a kill. This gun has no recoil penalty.
item.starrailexpress.sniper_rifle.desc: Has an extremely long range, a slower fire rate, requires Magnum rounds to load, and can mount a scope. Crouch + right-click to aim. Hitting a player beyond 50 blocks ignores their shield and kills them.
item.starrailexpress.magnum_bullet.desc: Large-caliber bullet used to load the sniper rifle.
item.starrailexpress.scope.desc: A scope that can be mounted on the sniper rifle.
item.starrailexpress.body_bag.desc: One-time use. Removes a corpse on the ground.
item.starrailexpress.blackout.desc: When purchased, turns off all lights in the map.
item.starrailexpress.psycho_mode.desc: After purchase, the Killer enters Psycho mode, attacking with a bat in hand and gaining 1 stack of shield (except the Jester).
item.starrailexpress.poison_vial.desc: Can be right-clicked onto food trays and drink trays, poisoning the next player who takes food or drink after consuming it.
item.starrailexpress.scorpion.desc: Can be right-clicked onto a bed; scorpion venom spreads to nearby beds within a radius, poisoning players who sleep in them.
item.starrailexpress.mojito.desc: A Mojito cocktail, a refreshing drink.
item.starrailexpress.martini.desc: A Martini cocktail, a classic drink.
item.starrailexpress.cosmopolitan.desc: A Cosmopolitan cocktail, a fashionable drink.
item.starrailexpress.note.desc: A sticky note for recording information. Sneak + right-click to write text; right-click to stick it on a wall.
item.noellesroles.newspaper.desc: A newspaper from Shameimaru Aya; can write a title and body. When hooked by an Angler, it becomes Patchouli's book: it lists a wrong role for a random living Passenger and does not actually reveal the identity. Appears as a dropped item after being hooked.
item.noellesroles.giant_note.desc: Spawns a 5x-size sticky note. The Reporter can stick it onto other players.
item.starrailexpress.binding_tool.desc: A binding tool used to bind monitors.
item.starrailexpress.looping_mirror_tool: A mapping tool. First select a looping mirror, then frame two planes to bind to it. The client generates the opposite scene behind the mirror; walking back and forth loops indefinitely.
item.starrailexpress.vertical_looping_mi: A mapping tool. First select a looping mirror, then pick diagonal corners A and B. Passing through the top and bottom loops up and down; only a finite number of scenes stack above, while below is fog.
item.starrailexpress.nunchuck.desc: Nunchaku, the exclusive weapon of the Martial Arts Instructor. See the Martial Arts Instructor role for a tutorial.
item.starrailexpress.lockpick.desc: Right-click to open any door. Sneak + right-click a door to lock it.
item.noellesroles.pan.desc: A frying pan used to cook food, the Chef's exclusive item.
item.noellesroles.once_revolver.desc: A revolver that can only be fired once.
item.noellesroles.handcuffs.desc: Handcuffs. Right-click to cuff a player; a cuffed player can break free by continuously sneaking.
item.noellesroles.patroller_revolver.des: The Patroller's special pistol, with an extremely short firing cooldown.
item.noellesroles.night_vision_glasses.d: Night vision goggles. Provides Night Vision when worn.
item.noellesroles.diving_helmet.desc: Diving helmet. Provides Water Breathing and Dolphin's Grace when worn.
item.noellesroles.diving_boots.desc: Diving boots. Grants Depth Strider III when worn.
item.noellesroles.fake_knife.desc: A fake knife that looks like a real knife. Can be raised but cannot kill.
item.noellesroles.yinyang_sword.desc: A black-and-white weapon. Left-click: dash 6 blocks with black-and-white particles to kill. Right-click: after a 1-second windup, release a 4-block AOE kill.
item.noellesroles.fake_revolver.desc: A fake gun that looks like a real gun. Can only be fired five times and cannot deal any kills.
item.noellesroles.fake_bat.desc: A fake bat that looks like a real bat but cannot deal damage.
item.noellesroles.fake_psycho_mode.desc: A fake Psycho mode used to mislead others. The Magician's exclusive item.
item.noellesroles.fake_grenade.desc: A fake grenade that looks like a real one. The pin can be pulled but it cannot be thrown.
item.noellesroles.fake_lockpick.desc: A fake lockpick that looks like a real one but cannot be used.
item.noellesroles.fake_crowbar.desc: A fake crowbar that looks like a real one but cannot be used.
item.noellesroles.fake_body_bag.desc: A fake body bag that looks like a real one but cannot hold corpses.
item.noellesroles.delusion_vial.desc: Colloquially: fake poison. The player feels poisoned but it cannot be fatal; however, it can be catalyzed into a fatal state by a Catalyst.
item.noellesroles.defibrillator.desc: A defibrillator, the Doctor's exclusive item. Hold right-click on a player to use; if that player dies within 120 seconds, they revive after 30 seconds.
item.noellesroles.bone_book.desc: One-time item. Hold the Book of Bones and long-press right-click while aiming at a player corpse to charge; at full charge (1 second) it releases automatically: the dead player corresponding to the corpse revives on the spot as the Skeleton role, plays a Totem of Undying sound for the whole field and announces to everyone. It is not consumed if the corpse's owner is offline, the corpse is fake, or the target is not dead.
item.noellesroles.judgment_sword.desc: Dictator exclusive, one-time item. Right-click a player corpse, first select the cause of death (searchable), then select the killer; when both cause of death and killer are correct, lightning strikes the killer's position and they die (cause of death: Judgment). If the killer is already dead, it only prompts without executing. It is consumed regardless of correctness.
item.noellesroles.dictator_book.desc: Dictator exclusive, one-time item. Right-click to open a player avatar screen (all players); after selecting a player, guess their role (only non-good-neutral and Killer roles). If guessed correctly, lightning strikes the target's position and they die (cause of death: Judgment). Consumed regardless of correctness.
item.noellesroles.boxing_glove.desc: Boxing gloves, the Fighter's exclusive item. Hold right-click to raise the gloves; right-click to knock a player back, stun them, and put all items on them on cooldown.
item.noellesroles.antidote_reagent.desc: Hold right-click on a player to check whether they are poisoned. Has limited uses.
item.noellesroles.conspiracy_page.desc: The Conspirator's exclusive item. Right-click to open the page and guess a role; a player whose role is guessed correctly dies.
item.noellesroles.blank_cartridge.desc: The Prankster's exclusive item. Right-click a player to put the revolver in their hand on cooldown.
item.noellesroles.smoke_grenade.desc: The Prankster's exclusive item. Throws out a large cloud of smoke on landing. 30-second use cooldown.
item.noellesroles.chlorine_bomb.desc: The Poisoner's exclusive item. Thrown to poison players within a radius of the landing point.
item.noellesroles.purify_bomb.desc: The Doctor's exclusive item. Thrown to cure poison in players within a radius of the landing point.
item.noellesroles.flash_grenade.desc: A flashbang. Thrown to blind players looking at it.
item.noellesroles.decoy_grenade.desc: A decoy grenade. Thrown to continuously emit gunshots.
item.noellesroles.reinforcement.desc: A repair tool. Right-click a door to install it, letting the door withstand one crowbar hit; sneak + right-click to uninstall items from the door.
item.noellesroles.screwdriver.desc: A screwdriver. Sneak + right-click to uninstall items from a door. A Locksmith can additionally use the screwdriver to restore a door to its original state (repairing doors pried open by a crowbar).
item.noellesroles.alarm_trap.desc: An alarm trap. When triggered by a crowbar it raises an alarm; the door the trap is installed on locks.
item.noellesroles.delivery_box.desc: Right-click a player to let a Courier and the recipient exchange items.
item.noellesroles.hallucination_bottle.d: 2 durability. Right-click to force players within a radius to jerk their camera around 3 times.
item.noellesroles.written_note.desc: The Recorder's exclusive item. Right-click to record a player's identity.
item.noellesroles.bomb.desc: The Bomber's exclusive item. Right-click a player to pass the bomb in hand to them; the bomb explodes after a while, killing the holder.
item.noellesroles.wheelchair.desc: The Old Man's exclusive item. Right-click to place a wheelchair on the ground.
item.noellesroles.lock.desc: A lock used to lock doors. When a Killer uses a lockpick, they must manually pick it.
item.noellesroles.pocket_watch.desc: A pocket watch. Right-click to view the in-round game time. 60-second cooldown.
item.noellesroles.adrenaline.desc: One-time use, the Alchemist's exclusive item. Right-click a player to increase the target's stamina cap by 2.
item.noellesroles.antibiotic.desc: One-time use, the Alchemist's exclusive item. Right-click a player to cure the target of poison.
item.noellesroles.hedinghong.desc: One-time use, the Alchemist's exclusive item. Right-click a player to poison the target.
item.noellesroles.toilet_poison.desc: One-time use, the Poisoner's exclusive item. Right-click a toilet to poison the next player who sits on it.
item.noellesroles.dogskin_plaster.desc: One-time use, the Alchemist's exclusive item. Right-click a player to prevent the target's Sanity from dropping for 30 seconds.
One-time use. Right-click a player to randomly apply one of the following 6 buffs: reduced Sanity drain, Sanity drain immunity, Sanity recovery, infinite stamina, increased stamina, or faster stamina recovery; and tells the target which effect they received.
item.noellesroles.fire_axe.desc: The Firefighter's exclusive item. Has 3 durability. Hold right-click to raise the fire axe and kill a target; a kill directly consumes 3 durability. Can also sneak + right-click a door to break it open, consuming 1 durability. When the fire axe is not at full durability, you cannot axe-kill with it.
item.noellesroles.dream_axe.desc: Dream's exclusive weapon, 12 durability, half price on the second shop purchase. Left-click attack (the charge bar must be full): drains the target's virtual health; a normal hit deals 9 damage, a jumping slash (attack while falling) deals 12 damage; during Rampage this becomes 12/20, and the target is also knocked back. A hit player is stunned for 1 second (2 seconds during Rampage): cannot move, cannot use skills or items, cannot open inventory, vision is restricted. Right-click to jump in place (0.2-second cooldown); when more than 3 blocks above the ground you cannot jump and enter a 1.5-second penalty cooldown.
item.noellesroles.dream_mask.desc: Dream's exclusive ability (takes effect on purchase, does not occupy inventory). On purchase, immediately enters Rampage state (insanity logic, with 1 stack of shield): iron axe damage increased, stun lengthened, attack range +1, and nearby players who see you suffer vision restriction, slowness, and trembling from fear; chase music also plays during Rampage. 120-second cooldown.
item.noellesroles.dream_pickaxe.desc: Dream's exclusive item. Right-click a locked door directly to open it like a lockpick; sneak + right-click to pry the door open directly (50-second cooldown), but cannot lock doors. Prying a door is very noisy, producing a loud breaking sound that nearby players can hear.
item.noellesroles.dream_boat.desc: Dream's exclusive item. Use on the ground to place a boat; nearby players are forcibly pulled onto it and cannot disembark until the boat disappears. The boat disappears after 10 seconds. 60-second cooldown, the item is not consumed.
item.noellesroles.area_blackout.desc: Dream's exclusive ability (takes effect on purchase, does not occupy inventory). On purchase, immediately extinguishes all lights within a 30-block radius centered on you and triggers blackout blindness. Cooldown is the same as a normal blackout.
item.noellesroles.dream_wine.desc: Wine brewed by Dream's winemaking skill. Drinking it makes you invisible for 10 seconds; during this time you cannot attack or be hurt.
item.noellesroles.throwing_knife.desc: Press Q to throw. Right-click to raise the throwing knife and deal a kill.
item.noellesroles.rope.desc: The Rescuer's exclusive item. Right-click to pull one person within a straight line in front of you.
item.noellesroles.extinguisher.desc: The Firefighter's exclusive item. Has 5 durability. Right-click or hold right-click to spray at a player; the sprayed player gains Slowness and Blindness, and it removes gasoline poured on them by an Arsonist.
item.noellesroles.passbook.desc: The Accountant's exclusive item. Right-click to deposit the coins on you into the passbook (at most 300 coins). When the Accountant dies, the passbook is passed to a nearby good player; the passbook can be dropped.
item.noellesroles.alchemy_material.desc: The Alchemist's exclusive item, used to brew potions.
item.noellesroles.signature_paper.desc: The Star's exclusive item. Right-click to sign; sneak + right-click to sign a life-and-death contract. See the Star role introduction for details.
item.noellesroles.life_and_death_shape.d: A life-and-death contract that lets the Star absorb one hit of damage for you.
item.noellesroles.signed_paper.desc: A signed paper. The holder continuously sees through the Star's position and gains Speed I when looking at the Star.
item.noellesroles.bowen_badge.desc: Euler's One Punch. Not role-restricted; anyone who gets it can use it. Right-click to enter an attack period and bind the first target hit; the target cannot move, cannot use items, and is always fixed in front of the user. Right-click-attack 20 times within 6 seconds to kill; each attack hits the target. If it times out it cancels and enters half cooldown. While held, your arm is wrapped in a golden gradient. Can still right-click to open train doors.
item.noellesroles.shisiye.desc: Maid Sakuya's exclusive item. Drinking it grants Speed 10.
item.noellesroles.problem_set.desc: A problem set. Right-click to start solving problems; correct answers grant rewards, failures grant punishments.
item.noellesroles.antidote.desc: Right-click a player to cure their poison. After use it enters cooldown; the cooldown is faster when a Plaguebearer is on the field.
item.noellesroles.pill.desc: An edible pill. Bought at a Doctor's shop it is an antidote pill; bought at a Poisoner's shop it is a poison pill.
item.noellesroles.toxin.desc: One-time use, a ranged weapon. Right-click a player to poison the aimed player.
item.noellesroles.catalyst.desc: The Poisoner's exclusive item. Right-click to make all players in a poisoned state die.
item.noellesroles.bandit_revolver.desc: A revolver used by the Bandit and Executioner, with shorter range.
item.noellesroles.throwing_axe.desc: The Bandit's charged thrown weapon. Hold right-click to charge for 0.8 seconds then release to throw; the flying axe travels in a straight line, piercing and killing up to 2 players, then flies to a wall and sticks, disappearing after 5 seconds. If released before 0.8 seconds it does not fire. After throwing it enters a 3-second cooldown; the weapon stays in hand and can be reused.
item.noellesroles.bamboo.desc: A charged thrown weapon. Hold right-click to charge for 0.8 seconds then release to throw a 3D bamboo; it flies in a straight line, hanging up to 2 players on the bamboo along the way (they cannot get off on their own) until it sticks to a wall. From firing to disappearing takes 10 seconds total (including wall-sticking time). Insufficient charge does not fire.
item.noellesroles.bamboo_spear.desc: After right-click use, the bamboo model of the spear extends forward along your line of sight, at most 10 blocks long and lasting at most 3 seconds; touching a player immediately kills them and retracts, and it also retracts on touching a wall or on timeout. 3 durability, consumes 1 per use, 15-second cooldown.
item.noellesroles.stalker_knife.desc: The Stalker's phase-2 exclusive weapon. In normal form, right-click to charge a stab; sneaking lets it charge faster and keeps the original cooldown. In Assassin form it serves as a Psycho-compatible weapon: right-click to charge the hunter's knife then dash; hitting an enemy puts an uncooled hunter's knife on 5-second cooldown and the skill on 3.5-second cooldown.
An offhand knife the Stalker can buy for 350 coins; its cooldown is independent from the mainhand knife. On a hit in Assassin form, it prioritizes putting the uncooled knife on 5-second cooldown; both blades leave a light trail while dashing.
item.stupid_express.jerry_can.desc: The Arsonist's exclusive item. Right-click a player to douse them in gasoline.
item.stupid_express.lighter.desc: The Arsonist's exclusive item. Right-click to ignite players doused in gasoline. See the Arsonist role introduction for details.
item.starrailexpress.camera.desc: A surveillance camera; works like a real-world monitor.
item.starrailexpress.dark_toilet.desc: A dark toilet, a task block. Right-click to sit on it and complete the toilet task.
item.starrailexpress.light_toilet.desc: A light toilet, a task block. Right-click to sit on it and complete the toilet task.
item.starrailexpress.security_monitor.de: A security monitor used to view camera feeds.
item.noellesroles.monitoring_terminal.de: A remote monitoring terminal. First right-click a security monitor to bind it, then right-click to remotely view the bound monitor.
item.noellesroles.ninja_knife.desc: One-time use, the Ninja's melee weapon. Right-click to instantly assassinate a target, silently.
item.noellesroles.ninja_shuriken.desc: One-time use, the Ninja's ranged weapon. Hold right-click to fire, silently.
item.noellesroles.mercenary_contract.des: The Mercenary's exclusive item. Others may right-click to sign a hire contract, choose a target, and pay 175 coins; the Mercenary right-clicks a signed contract to receive the hire fee and gain a wanted target. Press Q to throw the contract.
item.noellesroles.riot_shield.desc: The Guard's exclusive item. Equip it in main or offhand and raise the shield to block one frontal attack and gain protection.
item.noellesroles.katana.desc:
The Swordsman's exclusive item.
【Moveset】Left-click three-hit combo: horizontal slash -> thrust -> downward chop. The blade only swings at full charge, and only advances to the next move after hitting a player; each move deals 6/7/7 virtual health damage (cause of death: Katana). The thrust moves you forward about 2 blocks and deals 7 damage to players hit along the way. If all three moves hit and the target survives, it immediately loops back to the first move; after killing a player it enters a 10-second item cooldown.
【Parry】Right-click to parry: 0.4-second windup, active for 1.2 seconds. During the active window you can parry any number of hits with no upper limit, but each successful parry consumes 1 durability (5 total durability, never drops below 1; at 1 you cannot parry). Parrying within 3 seconds after a move hits has no windup; an unlinked parry ends with a 5-second internal cooldown.
【Parryable Range】Same as the Riot Shield: revolver, knife, Derringer, bat, bow, trident, grenade, short-barrel shotgun, throwing axe, throwing knife, shuriken, explosive crossbow, and Dream's iron axe, diamond sword, war hammer, and katana. Note: parry only works during the active right-click parry window.
item.noellesroles.baton.desc: The Guard's exclusive item. A melee weapon with 4 durability. Left-click to attack and stun the target; if the target takes two baton hits within 4 seconds, it counts as a kill.
item.noellesroles.bone_staff.desc: The Undead Lord's exclusive item. A melee weapon with 5 durability. Left-click attacking a player injects 30%% infection into them, consuming 1 durability per hit. When the target's infection is full they are turned into undead.
item.noellesroles.leon_blue_herb.desc: Leon's exclusive item. Right-click to use immediately, refreshing the melee combat skill cooldown. Gained when only 6 players remain on the field; does not drop with the revolver when Leon dies.
item.noellesroles.leon_red_herb.desc: Leon's exclusive item. Hold right-click to use and give yourself a shield (does not stack). Gained when only 3 players remain on the field; does not drop with the revolver when Leon dies.
item.noellesroles.radio.desc: Right-click to use, enabling long-distance communication with other players.
item.noellesroles.speaker.desc: A portable speaker. Right-click to open the control panel, search, select tracks, and adjust volume. When on, you carry the 3D speaker on your shoulder and the sound source follows you.
item.noellesroles.short_shotgun.desc: One-time use. Right-click to charge and fire; the kill range smoothly increases with charge in a fan shape (2-4 blocks). Once the kill range reaches 3 blocks, players within 2 blocks of the current kill range outside the fan take 1 damage and are knocked back.
item.noellesroles.executioner_gun.desc: The Fool's exclusive weapon. Can only damage players with the Heretic effect (one-hit kill). Starts with 1 bullet; bullets can only be replenished through the Tarot Society.
item.noellesroles.honored_note.desc: Bought at the Fool's shop. Right-click a wall or ground to stick it, generating an indestructible text entity. Players press J while facing the note to pray and join the Tarot Society.
item.noellesroles.spirit_cloak.desc: Bought at the Fool's shop. Right-click to gain 5 seconds of invincibility; cannot attack, movement speed unchanged. 90-second cooldown.
item.noellesroles.pliers.desc: Has 1 durability. Single right-click to remove C4 and sticky grenades on players. Non-Fitter players disarming C4 or sticky grenades consume 1 durability. Fitters using bolt cutters consume no durability. Non-Fitters using bolt cutters to disarm C4 have a 20%% chance of detonating it immediately.
item.starrailexpress.drawing_board.desc:
You can obtain items by drawing their texture in the drawing board.
Right-click to open; draw in the canvas area, and when you confirm the system recognizes based on the drawing. After successfully recognizing an item you receive the drawn item and consume 1 drawing board.
If the item texture contains white, fill it with white in the palette; the system does not recognize the background white.
If image recognition fails, you can tweak a few pixels and try again; recognition is not 100%% accurate (random doodles may also coincidentally match other things).
 
You cannot obtain the following items through the drawing board
- Drawing board / grenades / lockpicks / bat / Derringer / scorpions / Sheriff team special weapons (except baton)
- Pistols only recognize as revolvers, knives only recognize as ordinary knives
- Chlorine bomb / purify bomb / toxin reagent / pills / hallucination potion / frying pan / sulfuric acid bucket / blank cartridge / key blank
- Neutral team exclusive items / fake items / Minecraft vanilla items
- Alchemist / Star / Fool / Time Delayer / Photographer exclusive items
- Other keys except Attendant key / crowbar / paperclip
item.noellesroles.zero_one_five_gun.desc: Exclusive pistol. Right-click to shoot; can fire three shots in a row. A hit gives Slowness II for 3 seconds; hitting the same target twice kills them. Regardless of hits, after firing three rounds it enters a 15-second cooldown. Range 30 blocks. When a Killer team member uses the Zero-One-Five to kill a Civilian, the Zero-One-Five drops as a revolver.
item.noellesroles.wreath.desc: A wreath. Continuously restores Sanity when worn on the head. Has 60 durability total; wears off 1 durability per second, and the effect ends when durability runs out.
item.noellesroles.shilijia.desc: A stone particle rack. Eating it immediately restores stamina equal to 50%% of your stamina cap. Can be bought by Daiyousei and given to teammates.
item.noellesroles.youlu_anchor.desc: Youlu exclusive, bought at the shop for 80 coins once. First use releases a spherical anchor that slides forward along the ground (visible only to Youlu); use again to teleport to the anchor and recall it, then enter a 30-second cooldown. The anchor lasts at most 25 seconds.
item.noellesroles.youlu_smoke.desc: Youlu exclusive, bought at the shop for 70 coins once. On use, releases a smoke wave pushing forward along your line of sight (including up and down) (can pass through walls, not instant): players within a 4-block radius along the path suffer 8 seconds of Blindness and Darkness; the smoke does not disappear on hit but keeps advancing, total distance 12 blocks. 60-second cooldown.
item.noellesroles.barbarian_knife.desc: An infinite-durability blade the Barbarian only gains in the Frenzy form. No cooldown; can only attack Neutral and Killer team members.
item.noellesroles.desperado_knife.desc: Only gained by a Loose End converted from the Refugee modifier. Inherits the normal knife's left-click knockback and right-click charged stab; after full charge it additionally dashes a short distance, and the dash itself deals no damage.
item.noellesroles.desperado_gun.desc: Only gained by a Loose End converted from the Refugee modifier. Properties are the same as the Derringer; the bullet path draws a red particle beam, and players near the beam gain Slowness V for 3 seconds.
item.noellesroles.chocolate.desc: Delicious chocolate. Eating it prevents Sanity from dropping for a short time (lasts 15 seconds).
item.noellesroles.calming_tea.desc: Calming tea. Drinking it slows Sanity drain (lasts 60 seconds).
item.noellesroles.talisman.desc: A talisman. Carried in the inventory, it reduces low-Sanity visual interference and slowly restores Sanity.
item.noellesroles.energizing_coffee.desc: Energizing coffee. Drinking it greatly restores Sanity and grants a speed boost (lasts 30 seconds).
item.noellesroles.cake_ingredients.desc: Right-click to unpack and obtain the materials needed to cook a cake.
shop.noellesroles.undead_lord.plague_fog: Release poison fog at your feet; within range, +5%% infection per second for 10 seconds.
shop.noellesroles.undead_lord.summon_cha: Immediately summon 2 temporary undead beside you, lasting 45 seconds. 60-second cooldown, and summons cannot exceed the undead cap.
shop.noellesroles.undead_lord.infection_: For the next 60 seconds, undead attacks double infection.
item.noellesroles.reasoner_compass.desc: The Reasoner's exclusive item. Automatically obtained 2 minutes after the game starts. Right-click to open the compass divination interface. Each submitted answer has a 35-second cooldown; reasoning all questions correctly grants an independent victory.
item.noellesroles.inferior_lockpick.desc: The Wraith's inferior lockpick. Inherits the lockpick's door-opening and locking properties; each successful lock opening puts it on a 15-second cooldown.
item.noellesroles.niaoshoushou_knife.des: Niaoshoushou's exclusive kukri. Inherits the normal knife's attack pattern, has 4 durability; can also pry small doors, consuming 1 durability per successful prying.
item.noellesroles.niaoshoushou_incendiar: Niaoshoushou's exclusive incendiary grenade. Reuses the existing incendiary grenade effect; after use enters a 45-second cooldown.
item.noellesroles.niaoshoushou_family_ph: Niaoshoushou's exclusive family photo. Right-click two Killer team players or a Magician separately to form a team; can only buy one per round.
item.noellesroles.niaoshoushou_missile.d: Niaoshoushou's exclusive loitering missile. On use it binds to the camera; the missile body flies forward automatically and follows your view up, down, left, and right. On hitting a player or the ground it explodes, setting players within a 5-block radius on fire and killing them after 1.5 seconds. 60-second cooldown.
item.noellesroles.emp_bomb.desc: Silver Wing's exclusive EMP bomb. Thrown forward; hit players cannot use items for 4 seconds and gain Slowness III for 4 seconds. After use, if the skill is not on cooldown, it enters a 15-second cooldown.
item.noellesroles.mechanical_bird.desc: Silver Wing's exclusive mechanical bird. On use you control its flight for 25 seconds alive. Shift to dash forward; it explodes after 3 seconds. Nearby targets suffer continuous Blindness but can still be attacked. On hitting a player or enemy it explodes (2.5-block radius): deals damage and knockback, blinds for 3 seconds, cannot use items for 3 seconds, cannot use skills for 8 seconds, deducts 30%% Sanity, has a 75%% chance to destroy 1 shield stack, and deducts 25 coins.
item.noellesroles.angler_rod.desc: The Angler's starting fishing rod. Must cast into water. Each successful reel-in or riding the rod consumes 1 durability (empty casts consume none). Sneak + right-click to ride the rod and glide horizontally for at most 6 seconds; 30-second cooldown after dismounting. If you get stuck in blocks the rod disappears and you are teleported to the last safe position along the path. Successful catches appear as dropped items at the bobber; grenades become grenade entities flying out. When durability runs out, you disappear and leave a False Angler behind.
item.noellesroles.error_angler_rod.desc: A rod that should not exist. Never breaks. Catches items that have appeared in this round, with error mutations. Items appear as dropped items; grenades fly out as grenade entities.
item.noellesroles.angler_living_carp.des: A still-living carp. Appears as a dropped item after being hooked; dies about 3 seconds after landing or entering the inventory, becoming a dead carp, and gives 30 coins to each nearby living player.
item.noellesroles.angler_dead_carp.desc: An already-dead carp. Becomes from a living carp dying; no other effect.
item.noellesroles.angler_ragged_boots.de: Appears as a dropped item after being hooked. Wearing grants Speed I and Jump Boost I; effects end on removal.
item.noellesroles.angler_vanilla_milk.de: Appears as a dropped item after being hooked. Drinking it only clears vanilla harmful effects and does not remove mod effects.
item.noellesroles.angler_flounder.desc: Appears as a dropped item after being hooked. Eating grants 30 seconds of Nausea and Night Vision.
item.noellesroles.angler_inverted_fish.d: Appears as a dropped item after being hooked. Eating flips your vision upside down for 15 seconds.
item.noellesroles.angler_abyss_shield.de: Appears as a dropped item after being hooked. Anyone can drink it to gain 1 shield stack.
item.noellesroles.angler_someone_key.des: Appears as a dropped item after being hooked. One-time key; shatters after one use on the nearest locked door.
item.noellesroles.angler_blinking_kelp.d: Appears as a dropped item after being hooked. While held, nearby players briefly glow and you gain Slowness.
item.noellesroles.angler_wet_ticket.desc: Appears as a dropped item after being hooked. Right-click to teleport to a random room, returning after 8 seconds. Each player can only benefit once per round.
item.noellesroles.angler_empty_wallet.de: Appears as a dropped item after being hooked. Empty. Only the smell of leather. Caught when there are no coins to steal.
item.noellesroles.angler_empty_coffin.de: Appears as a dropped item after being hooked. No one else can be fished up. Gives you brief Darkness.
item.noellesroles.angler_empty_holster.d: Appears as a dropped item after being hooked. Looks like a gun but cannot fire. Caught when no gun has appeared in this round.
item.noellesroles.angler_jumping_heart.d: Appears as a dropped item after being hooked. After right-click, for 10 seconds you can see the outline of the nearest player; your heartbeat becomes extremely loud.
item.noellesroles.angler_unaddressed_let: Appears as a dropped item after being hooked. Opening it sends everyone an anonymous telegram with jumbled word order.
item.noellesroles.angler_abyss_bait.desc: Appears as a dropped item after being hooked. On use, makes your next normal catch additionally pull a rare item.
item.noellesroles.angler_gloves.desc: Appears as a dropped item after being hooked. On use, mouse left and right are reversed for 10 seconds.
item.noellesroles.angler_hair_reel.desc: Appears as a dropped item after being hooked. On use, you cannot move for 2 seconds, then gain Speed II for 8 seconds.
item.noellesroles.angler_ink.desc: Appears as a dropped item after being hooked. On use, leaves a small patch of darkness at your feet; anyone stepping in gains Darkness.
item.noellesroles.angler_task_list.desc: Appears as a dropped item after being hooked. On use, randomly completes or fails a mild "task" (adds or removes coins).
Appears as a dropped item after being hooked. On use, the time you see jumps around for 20 seconds.
item.noellesroles.angler_false_tooth.des: Appears as a dropped item after being hooked. On use, your chat becomes jumbled characters for 8 seconds.
item.noellesroles.angler_error_air.desc: An empty item the error rod may catch. Has only a name, disappears immediately, and does not become a dropped item.
item.noellesroles.angler_empty_hook.desc: Appears as a dropped item after being hooked. May be caught when there is no item history this round. This place has not yet been written.
A sealed relic. Completing tasks grants bonus coins, but Sanity drains faster. Granted at round start by the Sealed Relics rule, or very rarely caught by an Angler.
item.noellesroles.sealed_blind_lantern.d: A sealed relic. Occasionally illuminates nearby invisible or sneaking people, but your vision periodically dims, more noticeably at low Sanity.
item.noellesroles.sealed_rusted_anklet.d: A sealed relic. Constantly accelerates you; while running you may briefly dash or stumble out of control.
item.noellesroles.sealed_mirror_shard.de: A sealed relic. Has a chance to dodge one lethal attack, but skills are occasionally interrupted and fail by the reflection in the mirror.
item.noellesroles.sealed_breathless_brea: A sealed relic. Improves eat and drink task rewards, and eating may also restore a small amount of Sanity; each bite has an extremely low chance of choking you to death.
item.noellesroles.sealed_thunderbolt_nai: A sealed relic. Killing adds bonus coins or a brief speed boost; in open areas where you can see the sky it may attract a lightning strike.
item.noellesroles.sealed_vanishing_cloak: A sealed relic. Right-click to briefly turn invisible; on ending you glow and are exposed, and continuously lose Sanity.
item.noellesroles.sealed_doorless_key.de: A sealed relic. Right-click to short-range teleport and cross blockades, returning to the original spot after 4 seconds; the landing point may shift, even sending you into danger.
item.noellesroles.sealed_hungry_purse.de: A sealed relic. Slowly produces coins; spits out coins when attacked.
item.noellesroles.sealed_whisper_bell.de: A sealed relic. Occasionally tells you the direction of the nearest survivor, but the ring also distorts your vision.
item.noellesroles.sealed_splintered_comp: A sealed relic. Points toward the nearest Killer; the needle occasionally trembles and points the wrong way. Right-click the splintered compass to learn your current facing direction.
item.noellesroles.sealed_last_match.desc: A sealed relic. Right-click to ignite nearby people; the fire may also burn back onto you.
item.noellesroles.tomato.desc:
Dropped after Tomato Head dies.
Press Q to throw the projectile; it becomes a dropped item when landing on a block.
Walking through trips you for 2 seconds and picks it up.
Both the thrower and the tripped player's tomato enter a 20-second cooldown.
Hitting a player hands them the tomato and smears their screen with ketchup for 3 seconds.
item.noellesroles.loan_contract.desc: Right-click to repay the loan principal and interest.
item.noellesroles.insurance.desc: Choose a cause of death to sign insurance; right-click a signed insurance and pay 25 coins to activate it.
item.noellesroles.spellbreaker_potion.de: Spellbreaker exclusive. Aim at a living player and use to seal the target's next skill for 80 seconds.
item.noellesroles.silence_totem.desc:
Spellbreaker exclusive. Right-click to use, charge, then throw; the totem lasts 30 seconds after landing.
While present, living players within an 8-block radius who cannot use Killer abilities are repeatedly afflicted with Slowness II and Blindness I, fading about 3 seconds after leaving the area.
Only one silence totem can exist at a time; throwing another makes the previous one disappear immediately.
item.noellesroles.gong.desc: The Watchman's one-time item. On use, warns nearby players, making non-Civilian and non-Sheriff team players unable to use skills and inventory for 10 seconds. 120-second cooldown (rises 25 coins per purchase).
item.noellesroles.bang.desc: The Watchman's one-time item. On use, lasts 10 seconds, striking once every 2 seconds (ringing a bell) and immediately settling: deducts game time based on the number of nearby players (4 seconds per player). Over the whole round, Bang reduces game time by at most 1 minute; after it is exhausted, further strikes do not reduce time (but still ring the bell and grant Dreamwalking). It also gives nearby players 1 minute of Dreamwalking. 120-second cooldown (rises 25 coins per purchase).
item.trainmurdermystery.weak_defense_via: A weak shield reagent. A Loose End may right-click to drink directly; normal players may pour it onto a tray. Provides a weak shield lasting about 20 seconds that can only block one knife hit.
item.trainmurdermystery.virtual_defense_:
A virtual shield reagent. A Loose End may right-click to drink directly; normal players may pour it onto a food or drink tray. After being placed on a tray, the next player who takes the food gains 20 virtual shield after eating or drinking.
Virtual shield prioritizes offsetting virtual health damage but cannot block normal death.
item.noellesroles.sanity_meds.desc: Repair-mode sedative. Restores 40 Sanity on use. Darkness and approaching Hunters erode your Sanity.
item.noellesroles.terminal.desc: The Programmer's exclusive terminal. Right-click to open the terminal interface, type /give @s <item_id> or /tp @s room and press Enter to execute; after successfully executing one command, the terminal is destroyed.
item.noellesroles.netherite_spear.desc: The Cavalry's exclusive weapon. Left-click at full charge to thrust straight through multiple targets; right-click to raise the spear and charge, with faster speed dealing more damage. On hitting a player, vanilla damage is converted to virtual damage at 2x, and when it reaches zero the cause of death is "Spear". Only roles with vanilla special weapons allowed can use it to kill.
item.noellesroles.small_dried_fish.desc:
A small snack from the Fat Fish's shop.
Eating restores 40 stamina.
Because it counts as "food", others can also right-click the Fat Fish with it to feed it.
item.noellesroles.mushroom_sample.desc: The Mushroom Scholar's mushroom sample. Near a bed on a map with the sleep task enabled, it can be used to open the mushroom-cultivation minigame.
item.noellesroles.tray_purifying_reagent: A poison-clearing reagent. Place into a poisoned food or drink tray to clear both real and fake poison; does not affect shields or weak shields.
item.noellesroles.safe_mushroom.desc: A non-poisonous mushroom. Eating grants 20 seconds of negative-effect resistance.
item.noellesroles.poisonous_mushroom.des: A highly poisonous mushroom. Eating grants 20 seconds of Glitch and Slowness I, and 3 seconds of Puppet Wander.
item.noellesroles.mushroom_essence.desc: Mushroom essence. Right-click to throw; on hit, nearby players gain 20 seconds of negative-effect resistance.
item.noellesroles.recovery_pill.desc: A recovery pill. Eating fully refills your virtual health bar.
item.noellesroles.recovery_reagent.desc: A recovery reagent. Right-click to throw; on landing, players within a 4-block radius gain virtual health recovery for 30 seconds.
item.noellesroles.poisonous_mushroom_ess: Highly poisonous mushroom essence. Right-click to throw; on hit, nearby players gain 20 seconds of Glitch and Slowness I, and 3 seconds of Puppet Wander.
item.noellesroles.apprentice_wand.desc: The Magic Apprentice's apprentice wand. Right-click to charge 0.3 seconds and release the current spell; after a successful release, uniform 12-second cooldown. The skill-switch key cycles between unlocked spells.
